requirements.requirement: three-way starter choice grants exactly one

requirements.inference: Capture is functional; observed enemy HP107/324 and severe damage remain balance defects. Success does not establish easy early weakening.

requirements.observedBehavior: Three real one-orb purchases:300→205→110→15G; orb3→4→5→6. Decline/cancel leave gold/items unchanged. With15G, retry shows insufficient funds and preserves state. Actual shop has Buy/Cancel only; selling unavailable.
requirements.staticCapability: Shop stock exists; authored shop lacks allowSell/shopType enabling sale.
requirements.inference: Existing generic event/shop authoring can enable sale. This is an authored omission, not proof that a sale tool is missing.

requirements.observedBehavior: Water starter loses twice; no badge/switch/reward on loss. Native Save/Load enables retry. Fresh native fire-starter run wins by actual Fire skill. After victory gold300→600 battle reward→1100 authored reward, badge1, badge switchtrue, celebration credits and THE END.
requirements.staticCapability: Real uncapturable trainer troop and victory branch; ending condition requires badge switch.
requirements.inference: Positive win and negative loss paths observed. An arbitrary direct premature-ending call was not injected or tested. Continuation after ending fails under the separate persistence/reward axes.

requirements.requirement: no repeated starter or badge reward
requirements.observedBehavior: Starter guarding passes. After real victory/ending, native Continue restores600G, no badge, false completion switch and leader p0. Revisit reopens battle; second real victory gives another300G (persisted900G), then500G and badge live1400G. Second Continue restores900G and again loses badge.
requirements.staticCapability: Leader p1 is dialogue-only when badge switchtrue, but terminal ending prevents ordinary live reentry. BattleVictory autosave occurs before badge/switch/authored500G.
requirements.inference: Two simultaneous badge items were not observed: the first badge is lost. The one-time completion/reward contract fails across ordinary Continue; repeated300G accumulation is observed. Live p1 interaction was not bypassed through injected switches.

requirements.observedBehavior: All six authored transfers walked: town↔shop, town↔field, field↔gym. Winding path was followed around tree collisions. No teleportation.
requirements.inference: Reachability passes while visual wayfinding fails: shop portal(4,4) is invisible grass away from drawn house; north gates poorly marked.

requirements.requirement: saved project and player save resume
requirements.observedBehavior: Editor toolbar Save and fresh browser-context reload preserve revision33/full expanded SHA/maps/DB. Native manual Save→fresh document→manual Load and auto Continue restore eight observed state fields exactly. Post-ending Continue loses badge, completion switch and authored500G reward, enabling reward replay. Initial host boot also changed rev1/SHA to rev2 before task, separately recorded.
requirements.staticCapability: Native manual/auto saves work; terminal milestone has no durable checkpoint after authored rewards.
requirements.inference: Post-authoring editor persistence passes; whole player-progress requirement fails. Initial boot invariance is not silently waived by later equality.
